Nema vs Slackbot

Choose how AI should work in Slack.

Slackbot starts as a personal agent with native access to Slack context. Nema gives each channel a configurable coworker that the team can teach and direct together.

The short answer

Both products bring capable AI into Slack. Their starting points differ. Slackbot is Slack's personal AI agent, with native access governed by Slack permissions. Nema is organized around a distinct coworker in each channel, plus a personal coworker in direct messages. The channel can have its own instructions, memory, tools, and approvers.

That difference matters when a team wants one visible working relationship with an agent. Nema keeps the request, its context, and the review in a shared thread. Slackbot has the stronger native position for companies on an eligible Slack plan that want an agent grounded across the Slack environment.

A campaign review example

Suppose a marketing channel needs a Friday campaign review. The inputs are the approved launch plan, this week's performance export, recent channel decisions, and a list of metric definitions. The useful output is a short comparison that identifies changes, missing data, and decisions that need an owner.

With Nema, the team can teach the channel coworker which plan is authoritative, how the metrics are defined, and who approves changes. A teammate asks in the channel, reviews the result in the thread, and corrects a definition where everyone can see it. That correction can become reusable channel guidance. A routine can prepare the same brief next week as a draft for the channel to review.

Slackbot can use Slack context and connected tools to prepare the same kind of review. Its native integration helps when the relevant history already lives across Slack and the organization wants minimal setup. Slack currently documents a limit of 15 Slackbot messages per member per week on Business+, while Enterprise+ has different usage treatment. It also documents up to three automatic task runs per day. Check the current plan terms against the expected workload rather than comparing product labels alone.

Choose Nema when

Choose Nema when the team wants the channel to own the coworker. Different channels can give their coworkers different briefs, tools, memory, and approval rules. Nema also fits teams that want model choice and a shared pool of usage rather than one AI entitlement for every Slack seat.

This approach works when work crosses team boundaries but remains accountable to one operating channel. The record stays with the people who requested and reviewed the work.

Choose Slackbot when

Choose Slackbot when native Slack deployment and broad Slack grounding matter most. It is a strong fit for organizations already on Business+ or Enterprise+ that want to keep vendor count low. Slack also brings its established controls for retention, enterprise key management, data loss prevention, and the wider Salesforce ecosystem.

Slack announced channel use as an early pilot in its September 2026 product update. Buyers should verify which channel features are enabled in their workspace because that experience is changing quickly.

Rollout questions

Ask both vendors to run the same task with the same sources. Check whether the answer cites the right records, how a teammate corrects memory, whose credentials an app action uses, where approval appears, and what administrators can audit. For recurring work, test a missing-data case and an action that requires review.

Cost comparisons also need a workload. Estimate active requesters, weekly tasks, scheduled runs, and the number of connected actions. Slack plan limits and Nema credits measure different things, so nominal units do not produce a fair cost comparison.

Common questions

Is Nema a replacement for Slackbot?

It can fill some of the same jobs, but the products have different operating models. Nema focuses on channel-specific coworkers. Slackbot starts as Slack's native personal agent. A company can evaluate or use both for different teams.

Does Slackbot work in channels?

Slack announced Slackbot in channels as an early pilot on September 15, 2026. Its personal experience is already available on eligible plans. Confirm current workspace availability with Slack.

Which one can act with my app permissions?

Nema is designed to use the requester's connected-app access and channel policy. Slackbot supports app actions, MCP connections, approvals, and audit features under Slack's model. Test the exact app and action because a catalog listing does not prove every workflow.
